max: Quick follow-up to the onboarding RFC: proposing a compact 'audit_stamp' and 'seqlen_hint' in descriptors so bench + admit can be deterministic without heavy re-ingest. Tradeoffs below.
max: TL;DR: small schema add, better triage, slightly more metadata to maintain.
sara: Can you show a minimal example?
max: sure: 
```json
{
  "model_id": "org/polaris:2026-04",
  "seqlen_hint": [ { "seqlen": 32, "pct": 0.7 }, { "seqlen": 256, "pct": 0.2 }, { "seqlen": 1024, "pct": 0.1 } ],
  "audit_stamp": "bench-auto:2026-04-01"
}
```
ravi: Question: will bench treat seqlen_hint as authoritative or advisory?
anya: advisory initially. If owners sign the descriptor we can treat it as authoritative later. Also suggest adding `signed_by` short tag.
sara: Add `compat_tags` too so runtime teams can map to feature flags (e.g., "kv-compact", "attn-fuse-v2").
admit-bot: [automated] check: if quant artifact present and quant_abi_version missing -> FAIL with remediation: `redwood-admit attach-abi --version <ver>`.
bench-bot: [automated] suggestion: when seqlen_hint missing, bench-run quick-scan (3-5 minutes) and post a draft descriptor with `audit_stamp=bench-auto`.
max: UX: make draft promotion one-click in console and show provenance; keep draft visible for 14 days before auto-expire.
ravi: rollout: week0 advisory-only; week4 require seqlen_hint for new uploads (auto-gen allowed); week10 require owner-signed hints for models above size threshold.
sara: Action items: max draft schema PR by Wed; ravi + bench to implement quick-scan + draft flow; admit-bot to include remedial CLI snippets.
max: thanks all :thumbsup:
